prompt:
We have a pile of notes about our consulting contacts, clients, team members, and ongoing projects stored in /workspace/pkm_vault. These are just loose markdown files right now and nothing is structured or queryable. We need you to set up the full knowledge extraction pipeline for this vault so that:

1. All the structured data (people, companies, projects, relationships) gets extracted from the raw notes into a machine-readable knowledge graph.
2. A quality report is generated that clearly identifies gaps in our records — things like missing contact details, missing project deadlines, and any broken or unresolved references.

Please set everything up end-to-end so that the knowledge graph is populated and the feedback report (weekly-feedback.md) is ready to review.
